svg.title: tri_culture_v1: plan view
svg.text: Three-lineage differentiation and interaction chip v1
chip/tri_culture_v1.json · footprint 140 × 75 mm · plan view, to scale · all dimensions mm
channel (0.3 mm deep, in the spacer)
Chamber height is the 0.3 mm acrylic 'spacer' layer, so every chamber and channel is a cut-out in one flat sheet.
Groove barriers are drawn thicker than they are: each is an ARRAY of ~100 grooves 10 µm wide and 3 µm tall, which is invisible at this scale. They are not valves and cannot be closed.
They need photolithography, not the laser: see the stack and feature figures.
Tightest clearance between unconnected features: 0.59 mm, between channels 'ch_seed_mx' and 'ch_feed_mx'. Planar check: no overlaps.
